description:
The Samuhik Kanya Vivah Sahayata Yojana is a welfare scheme initiated by the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (UKBOCWWB). 

This scheme was launched on 1st April 2016. 

It aims to provide financial assistance to the daughters of construction workers for their marriage. 

The primary objective of the scheme is to support economically weaker sections of society by alleviating the financial burden associated with marriage expenses. 

The scheme specifically targets families of registered construction workers in Uttarakhand. 

Under this scheme, a financial assistance amount of INR 51,000 is provided for each marriage. 

The assistance is intended to cover various expenses related to the marriage ceremony. 

The scheme aims to promote the welfare of construction workers and their families. 

It also seeks to encourage the registration of construction workers with the UKBOCWWB. 

To be eligible for the benefits of this scheme, applicants must meet specific criteria. 

The applicant must be a daughter of a registered construction worker. 

The construction worker must have been registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board for at least one year prior to the application. 

The age of the bride must be at least 18 years at the time of marriage. 

There is no upper age limit specified for the bride. 

The family income of the construction worker should not exceed INR 3 lakhs per annum. 

This income limit is set to ensure that the benefits reach the economically weaker sections of society. 

The application process for the Samuhik Kanya Vivah Sahayata Yojana is straightforward. 

Interested applicants must fill out the application form available at the local UKBOCWWB office or the official website. 

The application form requires details such as the name of the applicant, the name of the construction worker, and the marriage details. 

Applicants must also provide proof of registration of the construction worker with the UKBOCWWB. 

Additionally, a copy of the bride's age proof is required. 

Income proof must be submitted to verify that the family income does not exceed the specified limit. 

The application must be submitted at least three months prior to the marriage date to ensure timely processing. 

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

The financial assistance is disbursed directly to the bank account of the applicant. 

The disbursement is usually completed within 30 days of the application approval. 

The scheme is implemented by the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 

The board operates under the Department of Labour, Government of Uttarakhand. 

For any inquiries or assistance, applicants can contact the UKBOCWWB office directly. 

The contact details for the UKBOCWWB are available on their official website. 

The scheme has been positively received by the beneficiaries. 

It has significantly reduced the financial burden on families of construction workers. 

As of October 2023, the scheme has benefited thousands of families across Uttarakhand. 

The government has allocated a substantial budget for the implementation of this scheme. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative to enhance the welfare of construction workers in the state. 

The UKBOCWWB also offers other welfare schemes aimed at improving the living conditions of construction workers. 

These include health insurance, educational assistance for children, and skill development programs. 

The Samuhik Kanya Vivah Sahayata Yojana is particularly significant in rural areas. 

In these areas, marriage expenses can be a considerable financial burden. 

The assistance provided under this scheme helps to promote social equity. 

It encourages families to celebrate marriages without the fear of financial strain. 

The scheme also aims to reduce the incidence of child marriages by promoting legal age marriages. 

By providing financial assistance, the scheme supports the dignity of the marriage ceremony. 

The government regularly reviews the scheme to ensure its effectiveness and reach. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is taken into account for future improvements. 

The scheme is a testament to the government's commitment to social welfare. 

It reflects the need for targeted support for vulnerable sections of society. 

The Samuhik Kanya Vivah Sahayata Yojana is an example of how financial assistance can empower families. 

It enables them to celebrate significant life events with dignity and joy. 

Overall, the scheme plays a crucial role in the welfare of construction workers and their families in Uttarakhand. 

It is an essential part of the state's efforts to uplift marginalized communities. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is a lifeline for many families. 

It helps them navigate the challenges associated with marriage expenses. 

The UKBOCWWB continues to work towards expanding the reach of this scheme. 

Efforts are being made to raise awareness about the benefits available under the Samuhik Kanya Vivah Sahayata Yojana. 

This includes outreach programs and informational campaigns. 

The ultimate goal is to ensure that no eligible family is left behind. 

The scheme stands as a model for similar initiatives in other states across India. 

It showcases the impact that targeted welfare schemes can have on society. 

The Samuhik Kanya Vivah Sahayata Yojana is a significant step towards achieving social justice. 

It embodies the principles of equity and support for the underprivileged. 

The scheme is a vital component of the welfare architecture in Uttarakhand. 

It demonstrates the government's proactive approach to addressing the needs of construction workers. 

The ongoing success of the scheme is a reflection of its importance in the lives of many families. 

The Samuhik Kanya Vivah Sahayata Yojana continues to evolve to meet the changing needs of society. 

It remains committed to empowering families through financial assistance for marriage. 

This scheme is an essential part of the social safety net for construction workers in Uttarakhand.
